If you ignore the fact that she’s an AV actress, she’s just your average college girl.

But one day, she dropped a bombshell.

“I’m dating our cousin, Micchan, with marriage in mind. So, don’t you dare tell him I’m doing AV, okay?”

Honestly, out of all the couples I’d seen in recent years, theirs was the most infuriating.

“Hey! You’re not planning to peek, are you?! I’ll give you some allowance, so go out for a bit!”

And then, through the wall, I could hear the creaking bed and their moans.
Meanwhile, on the monitor, there was my sister, getting pounded by an AV actor and moaning like crazy.
